# Recital preparation

The recital is in six weeks, twenty minutes of music in front of friends and family. The programme: a Bach prelude, a Schubert impromptu and two short pieces by Satie. The last fortnight is for run-throughs only, no more fixing details.

A dress rehearsal in the hall with a small audience is the best medicine against nerves. I play the whole programme without stopping, even when a note goes wrong, because the real thing has no pause button. The timing of the pauses between pieces matters too; practise the walk to the piano and the bow.

Afterwards, write down three things to improve and work on them in the next session.
